name: Roman Reine
source:
The world is guarded by the goddess Gertruz. The queen who governs this world is chosen from the best girl candidates. One of the candidates got ill and hero's nephew is going to try to become the next queen. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
世界由女神格特鲁兹守护。统治这个世界的女王是从最优秀的女孩候选人中选出的。一位候选人生病了，英雄的侄子将尝试成为下一任女王。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/09/vn-of-month-march-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
